1.text: Simon Peter, a servant N an apostle of Jesus Christ, 2 ’em dat have obtained like precious faith wit us through tha righteousness of God N our Saviour Jesus Christ:
Grace N peace be multiplied 2 u through tha knowledge of God, N of Jesus our Lord,
According as his divine power has given 2 us all things dat pertain 2 life N godliness, through tha knowledge of him dat has called us 2 glory N virtue:
Whereby r given 2 us exceeding great N precious promises: dat by dese y’all might be partakers of tha divine nature, havin escaped tha corruption dat is in tha world through lust.
N beside dis, givin all diligence, add 2 ur faith virtue; N 2 virtue knowledge;
N 2 knowledge temperance; N 2 temperance patience; N 2 patience godliness;
N 2 godliness brotherly kindness; N 2 brotherly kindness charity.
4 if dese things be in u, N abound, dey make u dat y’all shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in tha knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
But he dat lacketh dese things is blind, N cannot see afar off, N has forgotten dat he was purged from his old sins.
So tha rather, brothers, give diligence 2 make ur callin N election sure: 4 if y’all do dese things, y’all shall never fall:
4 so an entrance shall be ministered 2 u abundantly in2 tha everlasting kingdom of our Lord N Saviour Jesus Christ.
So I will not be negligent 2 put u always in remembrance of dese things, though y’all know ’em, N be established in tha present truth.
Yeah, I think it meet, as long as I am in dis tabernacle, 2 stir u up by puttin u in remembrance;
Knowin dat shortly I must put off dis my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ has showed me.
Moreover I will endeavour dat y’all may be able after my decease 2 have dese things always in remembrance.
4 we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known 2 u tha power N comin of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
4 he received from God tha Father honour N glory, when there came such a voice 2 him from tha excellent glory, dis is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
N dis voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were wit him in tha holy mount.
We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto y’all do well dat y’all pay attention, as 2 a light dat shines in a dark place, until tha day dawn, N tha day star arise in ur hearts:
Knowin dis first, dat no prophecy of tha scripture is of any private interpretation.
4 tha prophecy came not in old time by tha will of man: but holy men of God spoke as dey were moved by tha Holy Ghost.

2.text: But there were false prophets also among tha people, even as there shall be false teachers among u, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying tha Lord dat bought ’em, N bring upon themselves swift destruction.
N many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom tha way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
N through covetousness shall dey wit feigned words make merchandise of u: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, N their damnation slumbereth not.
4 if God spared not tha angels dat sinned, but cast ’em down 2 hell, N delivered ’em in2 chains of darkness, 2 be reserved 2 judgment;
N spared not tha old world, but saved Noah tha eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringin in tha flood upon tha world of tha ungodly;
N turnin tha citiez of Sodom N Gomorrha in2 ashes condemned ’em wit an overthrow, makin ’em an ensample 2 dose dat after should live ungodly;
N delivered just Lot, vexed wit tha filthy conversation of tha wicked:
(4 dat righteous man livin among ’em, in seein N hearin, vexed his righteous soul from day 2 day wit their unlawful deeds;)
Tha Lord knows how 2 deliver tha godly out of temptations, N 2 reserve tha unjust 2 tha day of judgment 2 be punished:
But chiefly ’em dat walk after tha flesh in tha lust of uncleanness, N despise government. Presumptuous r dey, selfwilled, dey r not afraid 2 speak evil of dignities.
Whereas angels, which r greater in power N might, bring not railing accusation against ’em before tha Lord.
But dese, as natural brute beasts, made 2 be taken N destroyed, speak evil of tha things dat dey understand not; N shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
N shall receive tha reward of unrighteousness, as dey dat count it pleasure 2 riot in tha day time. Spots dey r N blemishes, sporting themselves wit their own deceivings while dey feast wit u;
Havin eyes full of adultery, N dat cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart dey have exercised wit covetous practices; cursed children:
Which have forsaken tha right way, N r gone astray, followin tha way of Balaam tha son of Bosor, who loved tha wages of unrighteousness;
But was rebuked 4 his iniquity: tha dumb ass speakin wit man’s voice forbad tha madness of tha prophet.
Dese r wells without water, clouds dat r carried wit a tempest; 2 whom tha mist of darkness is reserved 4 ever.
4 when dey speak great swelling words of vanity, dey allure through tha lusts of tha flesh, through much wantonness, dose dat were clean escaped from ’em who live in error.
While dey promise ’em liberty, dey themselves r tha servants of corruption: 4 of whom a man is overcome, of tha same is he brought in bondage.

4 if after dey have escaped tha pollutions of tha world through tha knowledge of tha Lord N Saviour Jesus Christ, dey r again entangled in it, N overcome, tha latter end is worse wit ’em than tha beginning.
4 it had been better 4 ’em not 2 have known tha way of righteousness, than, after dey have known it, 2 turn from tha holy commandment delivered 2 ’em.
But it is happened 2 ’em according 2 tha true proverb, tha dog is turned 2 his own vomit again; N tha sow dat was washed 2 her wallowing in tha mire.

3.text: Dis second epistle, beloved, I now write 2 u; in both which I stir up ur pure minds by way of remembrance:
Dat y’all may be mindful of tha words which were spoken before by tha holy prophets, N of tha commandment of us tha apostles of tha Lord N Saviour:
Knowin dis first, dat there shall come in tha last days scoffers, walkin after their own lusts,
N sayin, Where is tha promise of his comin? 4 since tha fathers fell asleep, all things continue as dey were from tha beginning of tha creation.
4 dis dey willingly r ignorant of, dat by tha word of God tha heavenz were of old, N tha earth standin out of tha water N in tha water:
Whereby tha world dat then was, bein overflowed wit water, perished:
But tha heavenz N tha earth, which r now, by tha same word r kept in store, reserved 2 fire against tha day of judgment N perdition of ungodly men.
But, beloved, don’t be ignorant of dis one thing, dat one day is wit tha Lord as a thousand years, N a thousand years as one day.
Tha Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering 2 us-ward, not willin dat any should perish, but dat all should come 2 repentance.

But tha day of tha Lord will come as a thief in tha night; in tha which tha heavenz shall pass away wit a great noise, N tha elements shall melt wit fervent heat, tha earth also N tha works dat r in it shall be burned up.
Seein then dat all dese things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought y’all 2 be in all holy conversation N godliness,
Lookin 4 N hasting 2 tha comin of tha day of God, in which tha heavenz bein on fire shall be dissolved, N tha elements shall melt wit fervent heat?
Nevertheless we, according 2 his promise, look 4 new heavenz N a new earth, in which lives righteousness.
So, beloved, seein dat y’all look 4 such things, be diligent dat y’all may be found of him in peace, without spot, N blameless.
N account dat tha longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according 2 tha wisdom given 2 him has written 2 u;

As also in all his epistles, speakin in ’em of dese things; in which r some things hard 2 be understood, which dey dat r unlearned N unstable wrest, as dey do also tha other scriptures, 2 their own destruction.
y’all therefore, beloved, seein y’all know dese things before, beware lest y’all also, bein led away wit tha error of tha wicked, fall from ur own stedfastness.
But grow in grace, N in tha knowledge of our Lord N Saviour Jesus Christ. 2 him be glory both now N 4 ever. Amen.
